HorseArmor.desc: A heavy blanket and plated barding, ideal for a cavalier campaigning in winter.

HorseArmor.desc: A good saddle for marsh riding, and a specialized blanket to help protect your mount from biting flies.

HorseArmor.desc: A higher saddle and scalloped barding with scaled veil, ideal for a dusty, arid region.

HorseArmor.desc: A heavy blanket and structured saddle, ideal for the Fractured Peaks' colder regions.

HorseArmor.desc: Suitable enough for very long voyages, and cheap enough to replace.

HorseArmor.desc: Barding typically granted to the most prestigious of war casters.

HorseArmor.desc: Barding styled for, and suitable for, a luminary of any druidic order.

HorseArmor.desc: Scarlet barding and iron blinders appropriate for a mount of the Sisterhood.

HorseArmor.name: Lamplighter's Tack
HorseArmor.desc: Ample lamp-oil for a long night voyage, and fine leather tack to help in getting there.

HorseArmor.desc: A merchant's tack, for all to know it. A comfortable saddle, layered blankets, and dressings to show one's wealth.

HorseArmor.desc: The very lived-in kit of a traveling scholar, unflagging in the pursuit of defending Sanctuary from demonic invasion.

HorseArmor.name: Ashava Barding
HorseArmor.desc: There can be no mistaking where or how this was won.

HorseArmor.name: Treasure Beast Barding
HorseArmor.desc: There can be no mistaking where or how this was won.

HorseArmor.name: Bone-Caged Barding
HorseArmor.desc: The armor shifts and rattles as though disturbed by a heinous wind that does not exist.

HorseArmor.desc: Handled by the Butcher himself, this tack will never spoil. The mystery of its make remains; perhaps it was meant to dress a meal.

HorseArmor.name: Barding of Mount Arreat
HorseArmor.desc: Robust barding of iron, horn, and leather, and woad, for a horse as fierce as their rider.

InInventoryCrafter.desc: Removes twoPacts of Ferocity from a piece of armor.

InInventoryCrafter.desc: Adds aPact of Eternity to Helm, Chest Armor, Gloves, Pants, or Boots.   Has no effect if the armor piece already has maximum Pacts.

InInventoryCrafter.name: Cleansing Acid - Eternity
InInventoryCrafter.desc: Removes twoPacts of Eternity from a piece of armor.

InInventoryCrafter.desc: Removes twoPacts of Divinity from a piece of armor.
